simulator.note: Boots as the C3505 family (chips/c3505.py): its boot-ROM bootloader at offset 0x800 sets $sp to 0xBFE04000, unpacks the 10.3 MB maincode into RAM and starts it.  The application starts the SEE co-processor program ("M3505 SEE") at 0xA6000200, finds the internal S3505 demodulator via C3505.nim, drives the FD650K front panel on GPIO 107 / 108 (" O  ", " on ", "Stn ", "neAr", "nenu"), and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 "System Setup" OSD menu (12-15 GE commands, 146 unique colours) through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 204 firmware V1.3B2 (2020-07-31) for the H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 CI+ satellite receiver on the ALi C3505 SoC.

Unlike the Ariva 104 and T760i (which wire their FD650K SDA line to GPIO 110 and use GPIO 108 for another peripheral), the Ariva 204 wires its FD650K front panel to SCL = GPIO 107, SDA = GPIO 108 (like the Ariva 154 / 254 Combo), while sharing the same 63-key extended-NEC remote table (ext00).
